children: Sushi Launch V2 is live on Robinhood Chain by 04 Sep 2026, bringing the launchpad to a new venue with Moon Mode, a launch curve built on progressive V3 liquidity ranges. The release also adds tokenized stock pairs and expands creator-fee routing options, including a buyback & burn choice for token issuers.

The expansion gives SUSHI a fee surface on a high-profile retail-oriented chain, where launchpad activity and tokenized stock trading could route volume through the protocol. Moon Mode's progressive V3 ranges concentrate liquidity as demand grows, which affects how launch trading depth forms. Fee routing choices, including buyback & burn, give creators direct control over how their launch fees return to token holders.
Actual usage and fee capture will only become measurable after the launch, so the near-term effect on SUSHI depends on how much issuance migrates to the new venue.
Sushi Launch V2 is coming Friday to Robinhood Chain.
And with it, a launch primitive nobody has ever tried before: Moon Mode.

title: Sushi: Launch V2 Goes Live on Robinhood Chain - By 04 Sep 2026
